'''Dee Fourpio''' was a [[Protocol droid/Legends|protocol droid]] owned by [[Elea Poista]]. Fourpio recognized that a mysterious figure operating on [[Cloud City/Legends|Cloud City]] was in fact [[Lobot/Legends|Lobot]].<ref name="Game" />
